origin.reason_for_split: WATCHERS remains the incident dossier for 2026-08-26/28; this branch is a persistent forward-looking threat-intelligence and forecasting surface.

plateaus: Long-run Donbas attitudes cannot be reduced to propaganda alone because war, coercion, identity, local grievances and displacement confound causal attribution.
No causal design in this pass isolates the U.S.-federal-debt narrative itself as a driver of anti-U.S. attitudes.
Russian remote operational control of sovereign foreign DPI/SORM deployments is not established.
A synchronized multi-country external TSPU-like activation is not established.
strongest_historical_controls: Crimea 2014: rapid pre-event transmitter/source takeover and substitution
DPR/LPR-controlled Donbas 2014-2022: long-duration source seizure, institutional reconstruction and narrative production
Occupied Ukrainian territories 2022+: Internet routing into Russian censorship/surveillance environment
x50_r2_state.strongest_causal_media_evidence: Peer-reviewed natural-experiment evidence finds Russian television materially affected political preferences in Ukraine under some conditions, with heterogeneous effects and counter-persuasion among strongly opposed audiences.
x50_r2_state.long_narrative_result: U.S.-debt and Western-decline narratives persist across roughly fifteen years; U.S. debt contains a genuine factual fiscal-risk core, so only framing/unsupported extrapolation is coded as propaganda-like narrative content.
x50_r2_state.outreach_result: Evidence base is mature enough to draft a non-accusatory strategic early-warning memorandum, but not to allege an active global TSPU operation.

long_narrative_state.required_next_step: Quantify yearly frequency using broadcaster/state-media archives and denominator-controlled search rather than claiming all mentions were collected.

integrated_historical_to_digital_chain.pattern: PRECONDITIONING_NARRATIVE -> DISTRIBUTION_CONTROL -> SOURCE_REMOVAL -> SOURCE_SUBSTITUTION -> ALTERNATIVE_VOICE_PRESSURE -> HIGH_VOLUME_REPETITION -> CONDITIONAL_PERSUASION_POLARIZATION
integrated_historical_to_digital_chain.claim_limit: Historical recurrence and technical capability establish monitoring relevance, not present-day external Russian command.
